accessNotes: FIRST-PARTY-ONLY recapture on 2026-08-11. The live product widget still renders 'Total due / One-time payment / $0.00', while app.alphacapitalgroup.uk/FundingEvaluationPayments/89 returns 'You need to enable JavaScript to run this app'. No interactive browser session was available, so no fee was checkout-verified. The current official cost article remains published and unchanged with Published/Updated June 1, 2026; its 17 complete price rows plus the official review's single $577 Swing row are retained as firm-published but checkout-unverified. The 25K Pro conflict remains open: the cost article explicitly labels Alpha Pro 25K 6% at $137, while the official review still gives generic 'Alpha Pro 25K (2-step): $197' without a variant. The explicitly labelled 6% figure is retained; the figures are not averaged. Alpha One price rows remain variant-ambiguous because they do not say whether they buy One 6%, 10%, or 12%; rules below remain the 10% variant. No official prices were found for Pro 8%, Pro 10%, five Swing tiers, or any Direct tier; those values remain null. Help-centre lot-exposure tables mention $300K for several plans, but the homepage/product page advertise account sizes only up to $200K and publish no $300K price; no speculative $300K tier was added. The official review says 'Unlimited trading days'; maxTradingDays remains null because there is no finite maximum. On-demand is available on Pro/Swing/One/Three/Direct, while bi-weekly is available on Pro/Three; the scalar schema cannot represent both choices, so the existing representative schedule is preserved. Source URLs are canonicalised to the current Alpha One URL and the plan-specific Alpha Pro 6% help article.

globalRules.maxAllocationEvidence: The maximum allocation is $400,000, which is shared across all five plans: Pro, Swing, One, Three, and Direct.
globalRules.inactivityRule: If no trade is placed for 30 consecutive days, the account is deactivated.
globalRules.refundPolicyEvidence: All sales are final and no refund will be issued.
globalRules.eaEvidence: Expert Advisors are permitted on MT5 only for risk management and trade assistance, with pre-approval.
globalRules.eaProhibitedEvidence: Automated EAs that execute trades independently without human oversight are prohibited.
globalRules.copyTradingEvidence: Copying one's own verified external Master account is permitted; copying other groups or fellow traders is prohibited.
